premises.text: Cognitoys put internet technology inside toys so they learn and grow with the child
premises.evidence_span: putting the technology right inside of it and allowing it to grow with a kid as they get smarter

premises.text: Conversations stay witty yet educational, answering kids' questions with lasting interactive content
premises.evidence_span: creating that sassiness, that wittiness, but also being educational

premises.text: Parents get a dashboard for engagement analytics and controls including bedtime
premises.evidence_span: We also give them some sort of control. such as being able to set a bedtime

premises.text: Hardware sells near $100 with strong margins while subscription content/features escape cyclical toy seasonality
premises.evidence_span: We can move into a subscription type model, sell additional content, or also sell additional features in the future

value.text: Fun educational experiences that keep kids asking questions and laughing
value.evidence_span: Get kids laughing. Keep them asking questions and having fun at the same time

secondary_value.text: Parents can monitor and control engagement with the toy
secondary_value.evidence_span: view some engagement metrics analysis on how a child's actually engaging with a toy

causal_links.evidence_span: build a platform around the Dino

notes: Retail price and COGS folded into one commercial-platform premise with subscription. Competition awards excluded. Decade-ahead vision not coded as premise.
